name: monorepo
description: pnpm + Turborepo monorepo starter with Cloudflare Workers, Hono HTTP gateway, and React (Vite) frontend.

scripts.ci: pnpm run types && pnpm run boundaries && VITE_API_BASE_URL=https://worker-api-ci.monorepo-template.workers.dev turbo run //#lint:check //#format:check //#deps:check //#deps:format:check //#hooks:test //#release:check check-types test build deploy:check --continue=dependencies-successful && pnpm run react-doctor && pnpm run audit
scripts.ci:affected: pnpm run types && pnpm run boundaries && VITE_API_BASE_URL=https://worker-api-ci.monorepo-template.workers.dev turbo run //#lint:check //#format:check //#deps:check //#deps:format:check //#hooks:test check-types test build deploy:check --affected --continue=dependencies-successful
scripts.ci:agent: pnpm run types && pnpm run boundaries && VITE_API_BASE_URL=https://worker-api-ci.monorepo-template.workers.dev turbo run --ui=stream //#lint:agent //#format:check //#deps:check //#deps:format:check //#hooks:test //#release:check check-types test build deploy:check --continue=dependencies-successful --output-logs=errors-only --log-order=grouped && pnpm run react-doctor && pnpm run audit
scripts.ci:sandbox: pnpm run types && pnpm run boundaries && VITE_API_BASE_URL=https://worker-api-ci.monorepo-template.workers.dev turbo run --ui=stream //#lint:agent //#format:check //#deps:check //#deps:format:check //#hooks:test //#release:check check-types test build --continue=dependencies-successful --output-logs=errors-only --log-order=grouped && pnpm run react-doctor && pnpm run audit
scripts.fix: pnpm run types && pnpm run deps:fix && pnpm run deps:format && pnpm run lint:fix && pnpm run format:fix
